name: IntoGolf (incl. Proware and IkGaGolfen club apps)
location_or_channel: Netherlands (Bodegraven); web + branded club apps in App Store/Google Play
what_it_sells: All-in-one club software: member administration, tee sheet, POS, invoicing, competitions; branded member apps per club (e.g. Sallandsche, Golfpark Wilnis, De Kroonprins, De Batouwe, Lochemse, Amelisweerd); feeds GOLFGO via its Channel Manager
positioning_line: IntoGolf — Golfmanagement software voor golfclubs (page title)

name: Nexxchange (GolfSuite; took over E-Golf4U)
location_or_channel: Austria; cloud, web portal for members; >400 courses in the EU (2023 press release)
what_it_sells: Cloud golf club management (member admin, online tee times, tournaments); taking over E-Golf4U clubs in the Netherlands; tee-time payment via GOLF.NL from Feb 2026

name: E-Golf4U (being retired)
location_or_channel: Netherlands; web app m.eg4u.nl (not in the app stores)
price_of_comparable_item: not published; one POS link module from € 11.00 a month (leza.nl)
what_it_sells: Club software: scores and Q-cards, competitions, tee times, digital NGF card in a web app. Being discontinued; clubs migrate to Nexxchange, IntoGolf or Golfspot/TeeControl/Parrow

name: Golfspot + TeeControl + Parrow (Golfdashboard)
location_or_channel: Netherlands; Golfdashboard is a web app (not in the app stores)
what_it_sells: Best-of-breed stack: Golfspot (customer data platform / member data), TeeControl (cloud tee sheet), Parrow (Dutch competition module), Golfdashboard (member web app). Clubs incl. Bernardus, Kennemer, Bentwoud, Spaarnwoude, De Hooge Rotterdamsche, Amelisweerd, Prise d'Eau
positioning_line: the Customer Data Platform for the golf market (Golfspot)

name: GolfBox
what_it_sells: Member and handicap administration, tee times, kiosk check-in, member/guest app; vendor claims >1,000 clubs and 1.5 million players. Dutch customers not confirmed

name: Compu Partner (CompuGolf)
what_it_sells: Club software with a mobile app (supports GolfBox login where clubs use GolfBox); details could not be read

name: Golf Genius (Club App)
what_it_sells: Competition software and a fully white-labelled club app; used for competitions by at least one Dutch club until replaced by Parrow (Prise d'Eau)

name: GOLF.NL app + GOLFGO (NGF)
location_or_channel: Netherlands; free app (App Store, Google Play)
what_it_sells: Federation app: digital NGF card, scorecards and handicap, tee-time booking at ±65 courses via GOLFGO (linked to IntoGolf/Proware, CPS, eGolf4u/Nexxchange, Lightspeed Golf, Teecontrol), payment at booking since late 2025, 'Zoek en boek' from July 2026; open to non-members since April 2024

name: CPS / Lightspeed Golf / Teecontrol (tee-sheet systems)
location_or_channel: Netherlands; tee-sheet software connected to GOLFGO
what_it_sells: Tee-time booking systems used by Dutch courses; read automatically by GOLFGO. Details on CPS and Lightspeed Golf in NL not found

name: Golf@ (golf-at)
what_it_sells: Meeting platform for golfers, clubs and pros (find flights, club activities); last listed update 2016
positioning_line: Golf@ is het ontmoetingsplatform voor golfers, golfclubs en golfpro's

name: Club website + e-mail + phone at the desk
what_it_sells: Members book by phone or the club website, read news by e-mail newsletter, settle the bar tab at the bar; no app
